scope: Working-copy campaign selection, bounded driver, projection, console and synthetic exploration example. Unit tests and scripted owners over the real SQLite campaign store; no real worker, model, credential, provider or remote effect, and no deployment or lifecycle acceptance.
immediate_outcome: Independent ready campaign work is selected and driven while another member waits on review, context, replan, delivery capability or endpoint evidence; every member keeps its exact hold.
durable_capability: CampaignState::evaluate with retained member holds and a selection basis, and one bounded drive loop shared by the native controller and scripted owners.
